NCT06696755 and NCT07276997 Phase 2 recruiting test icalcaprant, an unapproved kappa opioid antagonist from Cerevel with no book row.
NCT07024784 Phase 2 recruiting tests IMGN151 (INN opugotamig olatansine), a biparatopic FR-alpha ADC distinct from Elahere and with no book row (https://www.adcreview.com/drugmap/imgn151/).
NCT06236438 Phase 2/3 recruiting tests livmoniplimab (ABBV-151), an unapproved anti-GARP/TGF-beta antibody with no book row.
NCT06365853 uses lubricating eye drops as supportive care to mitigate ocular toxicity during mirvetuximab soravtansine treatment.

NCT06602479 Phase 2 recruiting, sponsored by AbbVie, tests MEDI0618, an anti-PAR2 antibody that originated at AstraZeneca and has no book row (https://synapse.patsnap.com/drug/30ef7f91d8da41eda8f0e67117cb25ff).

NCT05445778 Phase 3 (GLORIOSA) combines two approved molecules: mirvetuximab soravtansine (EMA Elahere 2024-11-14, AbbVie) and bevacizumab (Avastin in book); Elahere itself is absent from the ABBV marketed list; approval date: https://news.abbvie.com/2022-11-14-ImmunoGen-Announces-FDA-Accelerated-Approval-of-ELAHERE-TM-mirvetuximab-soravtansine-gynx-for-the-Treatment-of-Platinum-Resistant-Ovarian-Cancer

NCT06500273 (ALPHA3, Phase 2, Recruiting) passed its interim futility analysis in April 2026 with 58.3% MRD clearance against 16.7% for observation (https://ir.allogene.com/news-releases/news-release-details/allogene-therapeutics-reports-interim-futility-analysis-pivotal).
Alnylam's 8-K filed 2026-02-12 (0001628280-26-007491) reports a Phase 2 start for ALN-4324, an RNAi therapeutic targeting GRB14 for type 2 diabetes (NCT07465224, recruiting).
Alnylam's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 (0001178670-26-000062) describes ALN-6400 as a GalNAc RNAi therapeutic targeting plasminogen for bleeding disorders, in Phase 2 NCT07575308 (recruiting).

ALN-AGT01 RVR is a REVERSIR oligonucleotide built to reverse zilebesiran's angiotensinogen silencing (PubMed 38690653), tested only in zilebesiran-pretreated patients in NCT07553442, so its value is tied to zilebesiran.
Alnylam's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 (0001178670-26-000062) names mivelsiran as formerly ALN-APP, and the Mivelsiran row in this batch holds the same molecule.
Alnylam's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 lists mivelsiran (formerly ALN-APP), an RNAi therapeutic targeting APP, in CAA and Alzheimer's disease, with Phase 2 NCT07636811 recruiting and no approval.
Alnylam's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 describes nucresiran as its next-generation TTR RNAi therapeutic, a different molecule from Amvuttra (vutrisiran), in Phase 3 TRITON-CM NCT07052903 (recruiting).
Zilebesiran, Alnylam's angiotensinogen RNAi therapeutic, is in the 11,000-patient cardiovascular outcomes Phase 3 NCT07181109 (recruiting) with no FDA or EMA authorisation in the local tables.

ABP 206 is Amgen's proposed biosimilar to Opdivo (nivolumab) in a Phase 3 comparison in melanoma (NCT06054555, active not recruiting); the biosimilar itself is unapproved and not in the AMGN book (https://www.pearceip.law/2026/02/03/amgen-update-on-biosimilar-pipeline-nivolumab-ocrelizumab-pembrolizumab/).

ABP 692 is Amgen's proposed biosimilar to Ocrevus (ocrelizumab) in a Phase 3 PK/PD comparison in RRMS (NCT06700343, active not recruiting); the biosimilar itself is unapproved and not in the AMGN book (https://www.pearceip.law/2025/01/13/amgens-ocrelizumab-biosimilar-in-phase-3-trials/).

Avacopan is Amgen's marketed Tavneos (not in the book) here in a Phase 4 AAV study (NCT06072482, recruiting) and a paediatric Phase 3 (NCT06321601); the EC revoked the EU authorisation on 2026-08-06 and FDA has proposed withdrawal (https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/04/30/2026-08455/chemocentryx-inc-proposal-to-withdraw-approval-of-new-drug-application-for-tavneos-avacopan-capsule); approval date: https://www.drugs.com/history/tavneos.html

Dazodalibep is a CD40L antagonist fusion protein that met its primary endpoint in Phase 3 OASIZ 301 in Sjogren's disease on 2026-09-22 (NCT06245408) and is not in the AMGN book (https://investors.amgen.com/news-releases/news-release-details/amgen-announces-positive-topline-phase-3-results-dazodalibep).

Inebilizumab is Amgen's marketed Uplizna (EMA authorised 2022-04-25 per dossier, not in the AMGN book list) running new-indication and paediatric trials (NCT07598825 autoimmune hepatitis, NCT06987539 paediatric gMG); approval date: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2020/06/11/2047190/0/en/viela-bio-announces-u-s-fda-approval-of-uplizna-inebilizumab-cdon-for-the-treatment-of-neuromyelitis-optica-spectrum-disorder-nmosd.html

NCT06747858 (Phase 2, Recruiting) tests Arcturus's inhaled CFTR mRNA, and the company expects a Phase 3 decision in Q4 2026 (https://ir.arcturusrx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/arcturus-therapeutics-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial).

NCT06488313 (Phase 2, Recruiting) is Arcturus's own mRNA study in OTC deficiency, and Arcturus's Q2 2026 release says dosing is complete with an End-of-Phase 2 meeting in preparation (https://ir.arcturusrx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/arcturus-therapeutics-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial).

Adimanebart is the INN for ARGX-119, a MuSK agonist antibody with a Phase 3 CMS trial not yet recruiting (NCT07746089); it is the clearer-named of two population rows for this molecule (https://accp1.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/jcph.70208).
ARGX-117 is the development code of empasiprubart, held in this population as the row Empasiprubart (https://argenx.com/pipeline/empasiprubart).
ARGX-119 is the development code of adimanebart, which this population holds as the row Adimanebart IV (https://accp1.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/jcph.70208).

Efgartigimod PH20 SC is the subcutaneous product sold as Vyvgart Hytrulo, a marketed ARGX row, and Vyvgart holds EMA authorisation from 2022-08-10 per the dossier; approval date: https://www.drugs.com/history/vyvgart.html

Empasiprubart (ex ARGX-117), an anti-C2 antibody, is in recruiting Phase 3 CIDP trials (NCT06920004, NCT07091630) with no model in the book; the only other book row, empasiprubart SC AI (id 1605), is unmodelled.
ARO-RAGE is an inhaled RAGE-targeting siRNA in a recruiting Phase 2 allergen-challenge asthma study (NCT07241546), not in the book.

Plozasiran is Arrowhead's marketed Redemplo (FDA FCS approval 2025-11-18, EMA 2026-06-19 per dossier) running Phase 3 trials for the new severe hypertriglyceridemia indication (NCT06347003, NCT06880770) (https://ir.arrowheadpharma.com/news-releases/news-release-details/arrowhead-pharmaceuticals-announces-fda-approval-redemplor).

Zodasiran is an ANGPTL3 siRNA whose Phase 3 YOSEMITE in HoFH (NCT07037771) completed enrolment of 70 patients in July 2026 (https://ir.arrowheadpharma.com/news-releases/news-release-details/arrowhead-pharmaceuticals-completes-enrollment-global-phase-3).

NCT03628612 (Enrolling by invitation, completion 2043) is Autolus's long-term safety follow-up of patients already treated in earlier gene-modified T cell studies, so no product is dosed and the row is not one programme.

Obe-cel is already authorised as Aucatzyl for B-ALL (dossier EMA entry, Autolus GmbH, 2025-07-17), and NCT07053800 and NCT07139743 take it into new indications, lupus nephritis and progressive MS; Aucatzyl is missing from AUTL's marketed list in the book; approval date: https://www.fda.gov/media/183464/download

NCT07398417 (Phase 3, Recruiting) and NCT07637162 (Phase 3, Enrolling by invitation) test esreboxetine in fibromyalgia, and esreboxetine is not one of Axsome's marketed molecules in the book (Auvelity, Sunosi, Symbravo).

column7: NCT07029737 (Recruiting) adds acalabrutinib, marketed as Calquence in the book (EMA 2020-11-05 per dossier), to R-CHOP, whose components are all approved.

NCT07630714 (Recruiting) tests subcutaneous anifrolumab by accessorized prefilled syringe in patients aged 5 to under 18, a new route, device and age group for Saphnelo, which the book carries (EMA 2022-02-14 per dossier).
AZD0901 is the development code for sonesitatug vedotin (CMG901), the Claudin 18.2 ADC the book already models as Sonesitatug Vedotin (https://www.adcreview.com/drugmap/cmg901/).
AZD1163 is a first-in-class anti-PAD2/4 bispecific antibody with no INN and no row in the book (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41982149/), in the Phase 2 LaunchPAD-RA trial NCT07276581 (Recruiting).
AZD2389 is an oral FAP inhibitor for liver fibrosis with no INN and no row in the book (https://drughunter.com/molecule/azd2389), in Phase 2 NCT07610837 (Recruiting).
AZD4144 is berzanoflast, an oral NLRP3 inhibitor not in the book (https://adisinsight.springer.com/drugs/800076157), with Phase 2 NCT07215702 in sepsis-associated acute kidney injury Recruiting.

AZD6793 is an oral IRAK4 inhibitor with no INN and no row in the book (ATS 2025 abstract, https://doi.org/10.1164/ajrccm.2025.211.Abstracts.A3037), in the Phase 2b COPD trial NCT07082738 (Recruiting).

AZD7798 is an anti-CCR9 depleting monoclonal antibody with no INN and no row in the book (ECCO 2025 abstract P0506, https://academic.oup.com/ecco-jcc/article/19/Supplement_1/i1047/7967561); its Phase 2 trials NCT06450197 and NCT06681324 are Active not recruiting.

The name is the low-dose arm of AZD8965, an oral arginase inhibitor in the Phase 2b ARGiNAUT trial NCT07652658 (Recruiting) in IPF, and the book holds no other AZD8965 row, so this row is the only carrier of the molecule.

AZD9833 is camizestrant, the drug in SERENA-6 (NCT04964934), which FDA granted accelerated approval as Etcamah on 2026-09-04 (https://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/fda-grants-accelerated-approval-camizestrant-cdk46-inhibitor-esr1-mutated-hr-positive-her2-negative), and Etcamah is a marketed product in the book.

Balcinrenone is an unapproved mineralocorticoid receptor modulator with no row of its own in the book (related_assets_in_book lists only dapagliflozin products and other combinations), so the combination in NCT06307652 (Recruiting) and NCT07624305 (Not yet recruiting) carries new value in balcinrenone.

Both components are approved and in the book, baxdrostat as Baxfendy (FDA 2026-05-18, https://www.drugs.com/history/baxfendy.html) and dapagliflozin as Farxiga, and NCT06677060 (Recruiting) tests them together in heart failure.

Both components are approved and in the book, baxdrostat as Baxfendy (FDA 2026-05-18, https://www.drugs.com/history/baxfendy.html) and dapagliflozin as Farxiga, and NCT06742723 and NCT06268873 test the pair in CKD and hypertension.

BGF MDI 320/14.4/9.6 ug is the strength description of the budesonide, glycopyrronium and formoterol inhaler sold as Breztri (in the book) and authorised in the EU as Trixeo Aerosphere on 2020-12-09 (EMA entry in the batch dossier), and NCT06283966 (Recruiting) is its cardiopulmonary outcomes trial.
NCT06471257 (Recruiting) tests PT027, the albuterol/budesonide MDI sold as Airsupra, which the book carries as a marketed product (related asset id 1, NDA214070).

Dato-DXd is the abbreviation for datopotamab deruxtecan, sold as Datroway, which the book carries as marketed (FDA approval 2025-01-17 per fda.gov; EU authorisation 2025-04-04 per the EMA Datroway EPAR, https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/EPAR/datroway).

The name is a treatment-group label from NCT05498155 (Active not recruiting, neoadjuvant olaparib versus olaparib plus durvalumab), not a product, and the molecule is already in the book as Lynparza (EMA 2014-12-16 per dossier).

The name is a dose and schedule of olaparib, the monotherapy comparator arm in NCT03330847 (Active not recruiting, olaparib combinations versus olaparib monotherapy), and olaparib is already in the book as Lynparza (EMA 2014-12-16 per dossier).

Oleclumab (anti-CD73) is not in the book, NCT06606847 is Active not recruiting, and the AstraZeneca H1 2026 clinical trials appendix of 27 July 2026 still lists PACIFIC-9 (Imfinzi plus oleclumab) with data due H2 2026 (https://www.astrazeneca.com/content/dam/az/PDF/2026/h1q2/H1-and-Q2-2026-results-clinical-trials-appendix.pdf).

NCT04606771 combines Tagrisso (osimertinib), marketed in the book, with savolitinib, which holds no FDA or EMA approval and is already modelled in the book (related asset id 1699), so the row's value sits in the Savolitinib row.
Rilvegostomig is not in the book in any form and has Phase 3 trials recruiting in the dossier, including NCT06627647 and NCT07221253 (ARTEMIDE-Biliary02).
Taxane is the chemotherapy comparator in NCT04784715 (DESTINY-Breast09, T-DXd with or without pertuzumab versus taxane, trastuzumab and pertuzumab), not an AstraZeneca product.

Torvutatug samrotecan is the INN for AZD5335, the FRalpha ADC the book already models, and the dossier's own trial NCT05797168 is titled Phase I/IIa Study of AZD5335 (https://adisinsight.springer.com/drugs/800073214).

AB-1005 is AskBio's AAV2-GDNF gene therapy for Parkinson's disease in the Phase 2 REGENERATE-PD programme, with Japanese Phase 2 NCT07566429 not yet recruiting (https://www.bayer.com/media/en-us/first-participants-randomized-in-askbio-phase-ii-gene-therapy-trial-for-parkinsons-disease/).

BAY 3670549 is a GIRK4 inhibitor for pharmacological cardioversion of atrial fibrillation in a recruiting Phase 2 (NCT07625215) (https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/bayer-initiates-phase-ii-study-of-investigational-girk4-inhibitor-in-patients-with-atrial-fibrillation).

BAY3723113 is aficamten (Cytokinetics' Myqorzo), in Bayer's Japanese Phase 3 CAMELLIA-HCM (NCT07023341, active not recruiting); Bayer holds only Japan rights, licensed November 2024, and no book row carries aficamten (https://www.drugs.com/history/myqorzo.html).
BIIB017 is peginterferon beta-1a, sold as Plegridy, a marketed BIIB row (EMA 2014-07-18 per dossier), here in a paediatric Phase 3 (NCT03958877).
BIIB059 is the code for litifilimab, which the BIIB book already models as Litifilimab (extension NCT06044337).
Felzartamab is an anti-CD38 antibody in recruiting Phase 3 trials in IgA nephropathy (NCT06935357) and primary membranous nephropathy (NCT06962800), not in the BIIB book.

NCT06297226 Phase 2 recruiting tests arlocabtagene autoleucel (BMS-986393), a GPRC5D CAR T; the related book rows (Carvykti, Tecartus) are different molecules, and this INN row is chosen over the BMS-986393 row.
NCT07335562 Phase 3 not yet recruiting names BMS-986353 as zolacabtagene autoleucel, a CD19 NEX-T CAR T with no book row; chosen over the CC-97540 row for the same product.
NCT06121843 title names arlocabtagene autoleucel (BMS-986393), the same GPRC5D CAR T as the Arlocabtagene Autoleucel row in this population.

NCT06122779 Phase 2 active not recruiting tests BMS-986435/MYK-224, a next-generation cardiac myosin inhibitor with INN delocamten (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Delocamten) that is a different molecule from Camzyos (mavacamten).

NCT06268886 Phase 2 active not recruiting tests BMS-986446 (PRX005 from Prothena), an anti-MTBR tau antibody with FDA Fast Track in Oct 2025 and no book row (https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20251001695629/en/).
NCT06646276 Phase 3 recruiting (TIGOS) tests BMS-986489, an atigotatug plus nivolumab fixed-dose combination in which atigotatug is a new unapproved anti-fucosyl-GM1 antibody with no book row.
NCT07063745 and NCT07077434 titles name navlimetostat (BMS-986504), the same molecule as the Navlimetostat row in this population.

NCT07772531 Phase 2 not yet recruiting tests oral BMS-986511 (listed as evifacotrep) as monotherapy in major depressive disorder; no book row or approval holds it (https://sigma.larvol.com/product.php?e1=766953&tab=newstrac).
CAPOX is the background chemotherapy in NCT07221149 and NCT07221357, where the investigational agent is pumitamig.

NCT05413018 title names CC-486 as oral azacitidine for AML maintenance, the approved indication of Onureg, which the book carries as a BMY marketed product; approval date: https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/nda/2004/50-794_vidaza.cfm
NCT07015983 title names CC-97540 as BMS-986353 or zola-cel, the same CAR T as the BMS-986353 row in this population.

NCT07680764 Phase 2 recruiting is a BMS-sponsored study of imzokitug with pumitamig and chemotherapy in NSCLC; no book row shares the name and the dossier has no approval or EMA match (external identity lookup not run).

NCT07100080 and NCT06926868 Phase 2/3 recruiting test izalontamab brengitecan (BMS-986507), an EGFRxHER3 ADC with only a China NMPA approval on 2026-06-22 (https://www.biopharminternational.com/view/china-nmpa-approves-iza-bren-for-nasopharyngeal-carcinoma-marking-first-global-bispecific-adc-approval) and no book row.

NCT07076121 Phase 2/3 active not recruiting names navlimetostat (BMS-986504) as a BMS investigational PRMT5 agent; no book row or approval holds it, and it is chosen over the BMS-986504 row in this population.

NCT04810078 (CheckMate-67T) is the registrational trial of subcutaneous nivolumab, now sold as Opdivo Qvantig (book, BLA761381) and approved by the EC on 2025-05-28 (https://news.bms.com/news/details/2025/Bristol-Myers-Squibb-Receives-European-Commission-Approval-for-the-Subcutaneous-Formulation-of-Opdivo-nivolumab-Across-Multiple-Solid-Tumor-Indications/default.aspx).

The row is KarXT, sold as Cobenfy (book, NDA216158), and its Phase 3 trials NCT07011732, NCT07011745 and NCT07140913 add Alzheimer agitation and bipolar mania plus a KarX-EC formulation; approval date: https://news.bms.com/news/details/2024/U.S.-Food-and-Drug-Administration-Approves-Bristol-Myers-Squibbs-COBENFY-xanomeline-and-trospium-chloride-a-First-In-Class-Muscarinic-Agonist-for-the-Treatment-of-Schizophrenia-in-Adults/default.aspx
BioNTech's 6-K filed 2026-08-04 lists BNT113, an mRNA cancer immunotherapy, in the AHEAD-MERIT trial for first-line HPV16+ head and neck cancer (NCT04534205, Phase 2/3, active not recruiting).

BNT162b2 is Comirnaty, authorised by EMA on 2020-12-21 to BioNTech Manufacturing GmbH and carried in the book; NCT07798648 is a new COVID-19 vaccine study of it; approval date: https://www.fda.gov/media/151710/download
BioNTech's 6-K filed 2026-08-04 lists BNT166 as its CEPI-funded mRNA mpox vaccine at Phase 2, and NCT07379580 is recruiting with no approval.
BioNTech's 6-K filed 2026-08-04 (0001776985-26-000054) names trastuzumab pamirtecan (BNT323/DB-1303), the molecule the book already holds as its BNT323 row (id 1954).

BioNTech's 6-K filed 2026-08-04 (0001776985-26-000054) names pumitamig (BNT327/BMS986545), a PD-L1xVEGF-A bispecific partnered with BMS, in seven pivotal trials, with no approval and no other row in the book.

BioNTech's 6-K filed 2026-08-28 (0001776985-26-000061) terminated NCT04486378, the only trial on this row (adjuvant ctDNA-positive CRC); the molecule continues in adjuvant PDAC and the book also holds it as Roche's Autogene Cevumeran row.

CABA-201 is rese-cel (resecabtagene autoleucel); four trials are recruiting (NCT06154252, NCT06328777, NCT06121297, NCT06359041), and Cabaletta plans a myositis BLA in 2H27 (https://www.cabalettabio.com/news-media/press-releases/detail/128/cabaletta-bio-announces-2027-rese-cel-bla-submission).

The deramiocel BLA is still under FDA review, with the PDUFA date extended to 2026-11-22, so it has no approval (https://www.capricor.com/investors/news-events/press-releases/detail/354/capricor-therapeutics-announces-extension-of-pdufa-target).
NCT07486934 (Phase 3, Recruiting) is Dyne's registrational DM1 study of this molecule, and no other row in the book holds it.

FDA accepted the z-rostudirsen BLA for exon 51 DMD with a PDUFA date of 2027-01-21, so it is not yet approved, and NCT07608432 (Phase 3, Recruiting) is its confirmatory trial (https://investors.dyne-tx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/dyne-therapeutics-announces-us-fda-acceptance-biologics-license).

XL092 is zanzalintinib, a different molecule from Cabometyx; its CRC NDA has a PDUFA date of 2027-03-03, and NCT05425940 and NCT05678673 (Phase 3) are active (https://www.cancernetwork.com/view/fda-extends-review-of-zanzalintinib-combo-in-pretreated-metastatic-crc).
NCT07570862 (Phase 2 lupus nephritis, Recruiting) and NCT06308978 (Phase 1, Recruiting) are Fate's active trials of this iPSC-derived CAR-T, which no other row in the book holds.
ATV is atazanavir, Bristol-Myers Squibb's Reyataz, used as the cobicistat-boosted backbone arm in Gilead's pediatric HIV study NCT02016924, where Gilead's own products are cobicistat and F/TAF.
Denikitug (GS-1811) is an unapproved Gilead antibody in Phase 2 gastric/GEJ and colorectal trials NCT07546812 and NCT07527858 (recruiting).

Emvistegrast (GS-1427) is Gilead's oral alpha4beta7 integrin inhibitor; Phase 2 NCT06290934 in ulcerative colitis passed primary completion on 2026-03-04 and is active not recruiting, and no readout or discontinuation was found.

TAF is tenofovir alafenamide, sold alone as Vemlidy (FDA 2016-11-10, EMA 2017-01-09) and first approved inside Genvoya (FDA 2015-11-05), all carried in the book; NCT02932150 is a pediatric hepatitis B study of it.
Tenofovir DF is Viread (FDA NDA021356 2001-10-26, EMA 2002-02-04), which the book carries; NCT01651403 is a pediatric hepatitis B study of the same product.
Tilpisertib fosmecarbil (GS-5290), an oral TPL2 inhibitor prodrug, is in Phase 2 ulcerative colitis NCT06029972 (active not recruiting, primary completion 2027-01) with no approval.

Gilead and Arcus discontinued Phase 3 STAR-221 and Phase 2 EDGE-Gastric after the interim overall survival analysis, and STAR-121 also stopped for futility (https://www.gilead.com/company/company-statements/2025/gilead-provides-update-on-phase-3-star-221-study); zimberelimab has no programme of its own left.
NCT07654361 and NCT07654374 (ACCOMPLISH-1 and ACCOMPLISH-2, Phase 3, Recruiting) test Structure's oral GLP-1 agonist, which no other row in the book holds.

Adjuvanted RSVPreF3 is the Arexvy antigen with its adjuvant, and NCT07092865 (phase 2, active not recruiting) measures immune persistence and revaccination with the same vaccine; approval date: https://www.aha.org/news/headline/2023-05-03-fda-approves-first-rsv-vaccine-adults-60-and-older

Adjuvanted RZV is Shingrix, and its only trial NCT07712380 (phase 2, not yet recruiting) tests it for a new use, slowing coronary plaque progression in adults 50 and over; approval date: https://www.fda.gov/media/108274/download

The FDA accepted the bepirovirsen NDA for chronic hepatitis B with priority review and a PDUFA date of 2026-10-26, so it is unapproved, and the book holds no row for it (https://www.gsk.com/en-gb/media/press-releases/bepirovirsen-accepted-for-priority-review-and-granted-breakthrough-therapy-designation-by-the-us-fda/).

BLU-5937 is camlipixant, and GSK ended its development in refractory chronic cough on 2026-07-17 after CALM-2 missed its primary endpoint, which covers this row's only trial NCT07650084, while the IBS work sits under the Camlipixant row (https://www.gsk.com/en-gb/media/press-releases/gsk-provides-an-update-on-calm-1-and-calm-2-phase-iii-trials/).

GSK stopped camlipixant in refractory chronic cough on 2026-07-17 but kept the phase IIb BALANCE trial in IBS-D (NCT07519395, recruiting), and the book holds no camlipixant row (https://www.gsk.com/en-gb/media/press-releases/gsk-provides-an-update-on-calm-1-and-calm-2-phase-iii-trials/).

NCT06855160 tests the same investigational chickenpox vaccine given with a marketed MMR vaccine, part of the VNS phase III programme held under the Investigational varicella vaccine row, which is marked NEW.

GSK discontinued cobolimab at its Q3 2025 results after the phase 3 COSTAR Lung trial (NCT04655976) missed overall survival, and the EMA holds a notice ending its paediatric plan, so the dossier's paediatric NCT06521567 is a closing study (https://www.oncologypipeline.com/apexonco/gsks-trio-cancer-discontinuations).

dTpa is GSK's Boostrix, and its only active trial NCT07596199 (active not recruiting) studies it in Japanese pregnant women toward a Japanese label (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07596199); approval date: https://www.drugs.com/history/boostrix.html
NCT06920043 tests efimosfermin alfa in compensated MASH cirrhosis, the same molecule as the book's modelled Efimosfermin Alfa row.
FF/UMEC/VI is the Trelegy Ellipta single-inhaler triple, and its only active trial NCT05757102 (recruiting) extends asthma use to 12 to 17 year olds.

GSK3772701 is MMV367, a pyrrolidinamide antimalarial with no INN found, entering phase 2a in P. falciparum malaria (NCT07545681, not yet recruiting), and the book holds no row for it (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42268935/).

GSK3862995B is an anti-IL-33 monoclonal antibody with no INN found, in phase 2 for bronchiectasis (NCT07201051, recruiting), and matches no product in the book (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07201051).

Alector and GSK stopped the phase 2 PROGRESS-AD trial of nivisnebart (AL101/GSK4527226) on 2026-04-29 after an interim futility analysis, and the extension NCT07105709 still reads recruiting only because its record was last updated 2026-02-02 (https://investors.alector.com/news-releases/news-release-details/alector-discontinue-phase-2-progress-ad-trial-nivisnebart).

GSK4532990 is ARO-HSD, the HSD17B13 siRNA licensed from Arrowhead in 2021 with no INN found, in phase 2 for alcohol-related liver disease (NCT06613698, recruiting) and MASH (NCT05583344), and the book holds no row for it (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ARO-HSD).

The phase 3 trials NCT07780669, NCT07782970 and NCT07782957 name GSK5784283 as felcorekibart, an anti-TSLP antibody (NCT06748053), in COPD, asthma and nasal polyps, and the book holds no TSLP antibody.

HFA-152a is the low-carbon propellant for the reformulated Ventolin MDI and NCT07645248 (not yet recruiting) tests propellant exposure against HFA-134a, not a medicine; the reformulated product is already in the book as Salbutamol HFA-152a (https://www.gsk.com/en-gb/media/press-releases/gsk-announces-positive-pivotal-phase-iii-data-for-next-generation-low-carbon-version-of-ventolin-salbutamol-metered-dose-inhaler/).

HZ/su is GSK1437173A, the herpes zoster subunit vaccine sold as Shingrix (completed NCT02581410 and NCT03439657 name both), and NCT05371080 is a long-term efficacy follow-up in older adults, the approved use; approval date: https://www.fda.gov/media/108274/download

IDRX-42 (GSK6042981) is velzatinib, the KIT inhibitor from the IDRx acquisition, per the StrateGIST 3 abstract for this row's NCT07218926 (https://ascopubs.org/doi/10.1200/JCO.2026.44.16_suppl.TPS11588), and the Velzatinib row in this population is marked NEW.

GSK's pipeline lists an investigational varicella new strain (VNS) vaccine in phase III, run here as NCT06806137 and NCT06693895 (both recruiting), and the book holds no GSK varicella product (https://www.gsk.com/media/40yljs4u/q1-2026-pipeline-assets-and-clinical-trials-report.pdf).

The _Lot 1 suffix names a manufacturing-lot arm of the investigational chickenpox vaccine in NCT06740630 (recruiting), part of the VNS phase III programme held under the Investigational varicella vaccine row, which is marked NEW.

The FDA approved linerixibat as Lynavoy on 2026-03-17 and the CHMP gave a positive opinion on 2026-07-23, but GSK licensed worldwide rights to Alfasigma in a deal closed April 2026, so GSK keeps milestones and royalties only and the book holds no Lynavoy row (https://www.alfasigma.com/news-media/alfasigma-completes-agreement-with-gsk-for-linerixibat/).

The row is the low-dose arm of the GVGH iNTS-TCV vaccine against invasive nontyphoidal Salmonella and typhoid fever in phase 2 NCT07286370 (recruiting), and the book holds no other iNTS-TCV row (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07286370).

MenABCWY is the development name of Penmenvy, approved by the FDA on 2025-02-14 (https://www.gsk.com/en-gb/media/press-releases/penmenvy-gsk-s-5-in-1-meningococcal-vaccine-approved-by-us-fda-to-help-protect-against-menabcwy/), and NCT05087056 is a dosing-schedule study of the same vaccine.
MMB is the standard abbreviation of momelotinib, sold as Ojjaara, and NCT03441113 is an extended-access study in myelofibrosis, the approved use.
NCT07406360 tests the same investigational combined measles, mumps, rubella and varicella new strain vaccine as the MMRVNS vaccine row in this population, which is marked NEW.

NCT07742644 (not yet recruiting) tests an investigational combined measles, mumps, rubella and varicella vaccine built on GSK's unapproved varicella new strain, a combined product the book does not hold, in the way ProQuad sits apart from Varivax.

Mocertatug rezetecan is in five phase 3 trials in ovarian and endometrial cancer (NCT07286266 and NCT07286331 recruiting), has no FDA or EMA approval, and is a different ADC from the book's only related row, risvutatug rezetecan.
Ris-Rez is the short name of risvutatug rezetecan (GSK5764227), which this row's NCT07602777 names in full, and the Risvutatug Rezetecan row in this population is marked NEW.

Risvutatug rezetecan (GSK5764227), a B7-H3 ADC, has no FDA or EMA approval and runs phase 3 NCT07802704 in mCRPC, with the relapsed SCLC phase 3 NCT07099898 filed under Ris-Rez, and the book holds no row for it (https://www.targetedonc.com/view/b7-h3-targeted-adc-risvutatug-rezetecan-extends-survival-in-small-cell-lung-cancer).

RSVPreF3 OA is the development name of Arexvy, and NCT04732871 (active not recruiting) is its revaccination and persistence study in adults 60 and over; approval date: https://www.aha.org/news/headline/2023-05-03-fda-approves-first-rsv-vaccine-adults-60-and-older

RSVPreF3 OA is the development name of Arexvy, whose phase 3 efficacy trial NCT04886596 sits on this row, and NCT06534892 and NCT07220109 are revaccination and new-population studies of the same vaccine; approval date: https://www.aha.org/news/headline/2023-05-03-fda-approves-first-rsv-vaccine-adults-60-and-older

RTS,S/AS01 is GSK's malaria vaccine Mosquirix, which holds a 2015 EMA Article 58 opinion rather than an EU authorisation, and NCT07036159 (phase 2a, recruiting) tests reduced antigen doses and alternative schedules in children 5 to 60 months.

Velzatinib (IDRX-42, GSK6042981) is an unapproved KIT inhibitor in phase 3 against imatinib in first-line GIST (NCT07585266, recruiting), and the book holds no row for it (https://adisinsight.springer.com/drugs/800069789).

INCA033989 is a mutant-CALR antibody in a recruiting Phase 3 against best available therapy in essential thrombocythemia (NCT07623200), not in the INCY book; no INN published (https://investor.incyte.com/news-releases/news-release-details/positive-late-breaking-data-incytes-first-class-mutcalr-targeted).

INCA33890 is a TGFbR2xPD-1 bispecific antibody in a recruiting 700-patient Phase 3 first-line MSS colorectal trial (NCT07284849), not in the INCY book (https://investor.incyte.com/news-releases/news-release-details/incyte-announces-phase-1-results-its-tgfbr2pd-1-bispecific).

INCB000928 is zilurgisertib, whose FOP trial NCT05090891 is recruiting and whose NDA has a PDUFA date of 2026-09-26, but Incyte licensed worldwide rights to Mirum in April 2026 for royalties, so value to INCY is royalty-only (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1759425/000175942526000036/mirm-20260506xexx991.htm).
INCB123667 is a selective CDK2 inhibitor in a recruiting Phase 3 in cyclin E1-overexpressing platinum-resistant ovarian cancer (NCT07214779), not in the INCY book; no INN published.

Povorcitinib has a CHMP positive opinion (Povofortay, 2026-09-17) with no EC decision yet and remains under FDA review, with HS and prurigo nodularis Phase 3 trials active (NCT06212999, NCT06516952) (https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/medicines/human/EPAR/povofortay).

ION363 is ulefnersen, whose Phase 3 FUSION in FUS-ALS (NCT04768972) met its primary endpoint on 2026-09-22 and is not in the IONS book (https://ir.ionis.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ionis-announces-positive-topline-results-phase-3-fusion-study).
ION775 is a GalNAc siRNA against APOC3, a different molecule from olezarsen (Tryngolza), in a recruiting Phase 2 (NCT07604974) (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42660799/).
Obudanersen (ION582) is an antisense oligonucleotide for Angelman syndrome in the recruiting Phase 3 REVEAL (NCT06914609), not in the IONS book.

NCT05727904 (Phase 3, Recruiting) tests lifileucel plus pembrolizumab against pembrolizumab alone, and both parts are already in the book: Amtagvi as an IOVA marketed product and Keytruda as a modelled MRK product; approval date: https://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/fda-grants-accelerated-approval-lifileucel-unresectable-or-metastatic-melanoma

NCT04614103 is IOV-LUN-202, which Iovance calls a registrational trial of lifileucel in NSCLC leading to a supplemental BLA, so LN-145 is Amtagvi's TIL product in a new indication (https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/iovance-biotherapeutics-reports-potential-best-in-class-clinical-data-for-lifileucel-til-cell-therapy-in-advanced-non-small-cell-lung-cancer-nsclc); approval date: https://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/fda-grants-accelerated-approval-lifileucel-unresectable-or-metastatic-melanoma

Cetrelimab is an unapproved anti-PD-1 J&J uses only as a combination partner; SunRISe-2 (TAR-200 plus cetrelimab, NCT04658862) was discontinued for futility in September 2024 (https://www.jnj.com/media-center/press-releases/johnson-johnson-statement-on-the-sunrise-2-study), and no J&J filing names cetrelimab as a programme of its own.
NCT06800313 is titled HLD-0915 (JNJ-101556143), which J&J's 10-K filed 2026-02-11 (0000200406-26-000016) records as acquired Halda IPR&D for prostate cancer, with no approval.

NCT04133636 describes JNJ-68284528 as J&J's BCMA-directed CAR-T, which is ciltacabtagene autoleucel, authorised by EMA as Carvykti on 2022-05-25 and carried in the book; approval date: https://www.fda.gov/media/156572/download

J&J describes JNJ-78934804 (JNJ-4804) as a co-antibody therapy of guselkumab and golimumab (https://www.jnjmedicalconnect.com/products/tremfya/medical-content/jnj78934804-golimumab-and-guselkumab-vs-simponi-or-tremfya-monotherapy-in-ulcerative-colitis), both approved and carried in the book as Tremfya and Simponi.

A J&J spokesperson said the JNJ-1887 geographic atrophy programme will be discontinued after the Phase 2b PARASOL topline (https://www.fiercebiotech.com/biotech/jj-axes-eye-disease-gene-therapy-after-key-phase-2b-readout); the only open trial is extension study NCT06635148.
J&J code with no INN or target found in the dossier, local filings or web search; its only trial is Phase 2b psoriatic arthritis NCT07321873 (recruiting), and no book row or EMA entry matches it.

J&J code with no INN or target found in the dossier, local filings or web search; it is in Phase 2b atopic dermatitis NCT07230860 (active not recruiting) and Phase 2 asthma NCT07746687 (not yet recruiting), and no book row or EMA entry matches it.

column7: The niraparib and abiraterone acetate fixed-dose tablet is Akeega, authorised by EMA on 2023-04-19 and carried in the book (NDA216793, FDA 2023-08-11); NCT04497844 (AMPLITUDE) tests it in a new prostate cancer setting.
Seltorexant, J&J's orexin-2 receptor antagonist, is in Phase 3 for MDD (NCT07573176 and NCT06559306, recruiting) with no FDA or EMA authorisation in the local approvals or EMA tables.
TAR-200 is the gemcitabine intravesical system FDA approved as Inlexzo on 2025-09-09 (NDA219683) on the SunRISe-1 study named in J&J's 10-K filed 2026-02-11, and the book carries Inlexzo.

J&J's 8-K filed 2026-04-14 (0000200406-26-000076) renames TAR-210 as Erda-iDRS, the erdafitinib intravesical system the book already holds as its Erdafitinib Intravesical Delivery System row, and erdafitinib itself is sold as Balversa.

Krystal describes KB803 as a redosable ophthalmic formulation of B-VEC for DEB corneal abrasions, and NCT07016750 (Phase 3, Recruiting) tests it, so it extends VYJUVEK, which the book carries (https://ir.krystalbio.com/news-releases/news-release-details/krystal-biotech-announces-first-patient-dosed-phase-3-clinical); approval date: https://www.fda.gov/media/168356/download

KYV-101 is miv-cel (mivocabtagene autoleucel), whose stiff person syndrome BLA was only starting a rolling submission in 2026, so it is unapproved; NCT06384976 (Phase 2, Active not recruiting) covers MS (https://ir.kyvernatx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/kyverna-therapeutics-announces-initiation-rolling-sps-bla).
In NCT06193889 (KYSA-6) this row is the standard conditioning chemotherapy given before Kyverna's CAR-T infusion, a background therapy and not a product under development.

Gandotinib (LY2784544) has had no trial since its Phase 2 in myeloproliferative neoplasms (NCT01594723) completed in March 2015, and Lilly lists no programme for it; no discontinuation statement was found, which is why confidence is low.
Phase 2 NCT06643728 of bimagrumab with tirzepatide in obesity is active, not recruiting (primary completion 2026-01-16), with no terminated trial or discontinuation in the dossier.
Lilly's Phase 3 NCT07412756 of brenipatide (LY3537031) in major depressive disorder is recruiting, and no marketed or modelled Lilly row carries the molecule.
Phase 2 NCT07783802 of clazakizumab (LY5724886) in adults with elevated hsCRP is recruiting, and the book holds no clazakizumab row.
Phase 2 NCT06598943 of eltrekibart with mirikizumab in ulcerative colitis is recruiting, and the book holds no eltrekibart row.
LY3016859 is fepixnebart, an anti-epiregulin and TGF-alpha antibody (https://adisinsight.springer.com/drugs/800035775), and its appendix in chronic pain master protocol NCT05986292 is recruiting.

LY3305677 is mazdutide, a GLP-1/glucagon dual agonist in Lilly's recruiting obesity master protocol NCT06143956; its only approval is China NMPA for Innovent and the book holds no mazdutide row (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mazdutide).
Phase 2 NCT06897475 of LY3457263 against placebo on top of semaglutide or tirzepatide is recruiting; the trial record and the HRA summary give no INN or mechanism for the code.

Phase 2 NCT07169851 in chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting is recruiting; an ASCO 2026 abstract describes LY3537021 as a GIPR monoagonist (https://ascopubs.org/doi/10.1200/JCO.2026.44.2_suppl.TPS855).
Dossier trials NCT07219953 and NCT07545759 are titled as studies of Brenipatide (LY3537031), the molecule of the Brenipatide row in this batch.
Phase 3 NCT06119581 is titled First-Line Olomorasib (LY3537982); the book's only other olomorasib row is named Olomorasib test, an arm label that should fold into this row.
Phase 3 NCT06339008 is titled Lebrikizumab (LY3650150), the molecule the book carries as marketed Ebglyss; the allergic rhinitis and nasal polyp indications belong to that product.
Dossier trials NCT07401862 and NCT07426380 are titled Eloralintide (LY3841136), a modelled Lilly pipeline asset in the book.

Phase 2 NCT07215312 in type 2 diabetes after basal insulin is active, not recruiting; GlobalData lists LY3938577 as a glucose-sensing insulin with no INN, not a code for any Lilly insulin in the book (https://www.pharmaceutical-technology.com/data-insights/ly-3938577-eli-lilly-and-co-type-2-diabetes-likelihood-of-approval/).

Phase 2 NCT07533006 (alopecia areata) and NCT07533019 (vitiligo) are recruiting; AdisInsight (https://adisinsight.springer.com/drugs/800080492) and the trial records give no INN or mechanism, so identity rests on the code alone.
Phase 3 NCT07174336 is titled Tersolisib (LY4064809/STX-478), and the book already holds a separate Lilly Tersolisib row outside this population.

Three Phase 2 chronic pain master protocol studies (NCT07285018, NCT07641504, NCT07641517) are recruiting; Synapse lists LY4065967 as an oral AT2R antagonist with no INN (https://synapse.patsnap.com/drug/2b120d62eb2b4a2cbfd460ecf59c8e9a).
Dossier trial NCT07186101 is titled LY4268989 (MORF-057), so this row is the same molecule as the MORF-057 row in this batch.

Phase 2 NCT07483099 of LY4395089 with mirikizumab in Crohn's disease is recruiting; press coverage describes it as an oral FXR agonist with no INN (https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/eli-lilly-targets-crohns-disease-with-new-combo-trial-that-could-extend-its-ibd-franchise).

The row name describes a single ascending dose arm but carries LY4515100's own trials, including Phase 2 NCT07511816 in pain after third molar removal (recruiting), and the book holds no other LY4515100 row.
Phase 2 NCT07589608 and NCT07215559 of macupatide (LY3532226) alone or with eloralintide are recruiting, and the book holds no macupatide row.
Phase 2 NCT06226883 of MORF-057 in Crohn's disease is recruiting under Morphic, a wholly owned Lilly subsidiary; the LY4268989 row in this batch is the same molecule and points here.
Phase 3 NCT06653153 (TRAILRUNNER-ALZ 3) of remternetug in early Alzheimer's disease is active, not recruiting; remternetug is a separate molecule from Kisunla (donanemab).
Phase 3 NCT07213804 of sofetabart mipitecan in platinum-resistant and platinum-sensitive ovarian cancer is recruiting, and the book holds no other row for this ADC.
Phase 2 NCT07269210 of solbinsiran (LY3561774) in severe hypertriglyceridemia is recruiting, and the book holds no solbinsiran row.
Phase 3 NCT07218380 of vepugratinib (LY3866288, LOXO-435) in urothelial cancer is recruiting, and the book holds no other row for it.

NCT05641688 (Phase 3, Recruiting) is Lantheus's histopathology study of PI-2620; Tauklarify, approved 2026-08-13, is a different tau tracer, MK-6240 (florquinitau F 18), so the book holds PI-2620 in no form (https://www.neurologylive.com/view/fda-approves-tau-pet-tracer-mk-6240-alzheimer-diagnostic-workup).
NCT05450705 and NCT05285826 titles name the 9vHPV vaccine as V503, which the book carries as Gardasil 9; approval date: https://www.drugs.com/history/gardasil-9.html

FDA approved doravirine/islatravir as Idvynso on 2026-04-21, which the book carries as an MRK marketed product (https://www.merck.com/news/fda-approves-mercks-once-daily-idvynso-doravirine-islatravir/).
NCT05612035 Phase 2 (INSIGNIA-PH-COPD) is active not recruiting for inhaled frespaciguat; no discontinuation statement was found and no book row or approval holds it.
NCT07513376 names intismeran (V940), which the book already models as Intismeran Autogene.
The only active trial, NCT04980872 (MK-7075-006), is a rollover safety study for PROS and Proteus patients already on miransertib; no discontinuation statement was found and no book row holds it.
NCT07033494 Phase 2 recruiting tests MK-2214, an anti-pS413 tau antibody with FDA Fast Track and no book row (https://www.alzforum.org/therapeutics/mk-2214).
NCT07463183 Phase 2 recruiting tests subcutaneous MK-8690 in ulcerative colitis; no book row matches the code and the molecule is not public (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT07463183).

Merck already sells molnupiravir as Lagevrio under a US EUA while the EMA application was withdrawn, and NCT06667700 Phase 3 recruiting seeks a new prevention indication (https://www.drugs.com/history/lagevrio.html).

NCT05722015 tests subcutaneous MK-3475A, the product sold as Keytruda Qlex (book, BLA761467), with EC approval of the SC form on 2025-11-19 (https://www.merck.com/news/european-commission-approves-subcutaneous-administration-of-keytruda-pembrolizumab-for-all-adult-indications-approved-in-the-european-union/).

Merck discontinued KeyVibe-008 (NCT05224141) after overall survival met futility criteria at interim analysis (https://www.merck.com/news/merck-provides-update-on-phase-3-keyvibe-008-trial-evaluating-an-investigational-fixed-dose-combination-of-vibostolimab-and-pembrolizumab-in-patients-with-extensive-stage-small-cell-lung-cancer/).
NCT06864169 title names raludotatug deruxtecan as R-DXd (MK-5909), which the book already models as R-DXD.
NCT07829783 title names Sac-TMT as sacituzumab tirumotecan (MK-2870), which the book already models.
Completed trial NCT01254643 names V503 as the 9-valent HPV vaccine, which the book carries as Gardasil 9; approval date: https://www.drugs.com/history/gardasil-9.html

mRNA-1018-H5 is an H5 pandemic influenza vaccine, a different antigen from the marketed mRNA seasonal flu vaccine, in a CEPI-funded Phase 3 of 4,050 adults (NCT07496450, active not recruiting) (https://cepi.net/cepi-fund-pivotal-phase-3-trial-modernas-mrna-pandemic-influenza-candidate).
mRNA-1195 is an EBV vaccine in a recruiting placebo-controlled Phase 2 for MS relapse prevention (NCT06735248), not in the MRNA book.

mRNA-1647 failed its congenital CMV Phase 3 and that programme was discontinued, but Moderna stated it continues the Phase 2 in haematopoietic cell transplant recipients (NCT05683457, active not recruiting) (https://www.modernatx.com/media-center/all-media/blogs/phase-3-cmv-vaccine-readout-reflections).
mRNA-1982 is a monovalent Lyme disease vaccine in a Phase 2 of 366 adults (NCT07561294, active not recruiting), not in the MRNA book.

mRNA-4157 is intismeran autogene (V940), which the book models under MRK (id 2436); the Moderna/Merck 50/50 cost and profit share means the MRK model must carry both halves or Moderna's share is lost (NCT03897881, active not recruiting).

NBI-1065845 is osavampator (ex TAK-653), an AMPA potentiator in a recruiting Phase 3 adjunctive MDD programme (NCT06786624, NCT06911112, NCT06963021) that the NBIX book does not hold (https://neurocrine.gcs-web.com/news-releases/news-release-details/neurocrine-biosciences-announces-initiation-phase-3).

NBI-1065890 is a next-generation VMAT2 inhibitor distinct from valbenazine, in a recruiting Phase 2 tardive dyskinesia trial (NCT07365462); no INN is published (https://www.neurologylive.com/view/vmat2-inhibitor-nbi-1065890-phase-2-study-tardive-dyskinesia).

NBI-1117567 is an M1-preferring muscarinic agonist whose Phase 2 Alzheimer's cognition IND was accepted in August 2026, with NCT07832383 not yet recruiting (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/08/26/3351102/0/en/nxera-pharma-s-partner-neurocrine-biosciences-receives-ind-acceptance-from-the-fda-for-phase-2-study-of-nbi-1117567-for-alzheimer-s-cognition.html).

NBI-1117568 is direclidine, an M4 agonist licensed from Nxera, with four recruiting Phase 3 schizophrenia trials (NCT06963034, NCT07105098, NCT07227818, NCT07114874) and none of it in the NBIX book (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Direclidine).

NBI-1117570 is a dual M1/M4 muscarinic agonist from the Nxera collaboration, separate from direclidine, in a recruiting Phase 2 schizophrenia trial (NCT07288333); no INN found (https://www.biospace.com/press-releases/nxera-pharmas-partner-neurocrine-biosciences-receives-ind-acceptance-from-the-fda-for-phase-2-study-of-nbi-1117567-for-alzheimers-cognition).

Valbenazine is the molecule sold as Ingrezza and Ingrezza Sprinkle, both marketed rows in the NBIX book, and this row carries only Phase 3/4 label studies (NCT07105111, NCT06312189); approval date: https://www.drugs.com/history/ingrezza.html

NTLA-2002 is lonvoguran ziclumeran, whose BLA for HAE was accepted with Priority Review and a PDUFA date of 2027-03-10 after Phase 3 HAELO (NCT06634420) (https://ir.intelliatx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/intellia-therapeutics-announces-fda-acceptance-biologics-license).

Nexiguran ziclumeran (NTLA-2001) is in the Phase 3 MAGNITUDE-2 ATTRv-PN trial (NCT06672237, recruiting) after FDA lifted the clinical hold on 2026-01-27; it is the clearer-named of two population rows for this molecule (https://ir.intelliatx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/intellia-therapeutics-announces-fda-lift-clinical-hold-magnitude).

NTLA-2001 is the development code of nexiguran ziclumeran, held in this population as the row nexiguran ziclumeran, here in Phase 3 MAGNITUDE (NCT06128629) whose FDA hold was lifted on 2026-03-02 (https://ir.intelliatx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/intellia-therapeutics-announces-fda-lift-clinical-hold-0).

CagriSema combines semaglutide, sold as Ozempic and Wegovy, with cagrilintide, the unapproved component the book already models as its Cagrilintide row; Novo's 20-F filed 2026-02-04 shows the obesity submission in 2025.

CDR132L is the miR-132 antisense oligonucleotide Novo acquired with Cardior; after the HF-REVERT miss (https://pharmaphorum.com/news/novo-nordisk-microrna-drug-fluffs-its-lines-heart-failure) its two chronic heart failure Phase 2 trials NCT06979362 and NCT06979375 are recruiting, and no discontinuation was found.
Novo's 20-F filed 2026-02-04 (0000353278-26-000012) lists etavopivat (NN7535), an oral PKR activator, in Phase 3 for sickle cell disease, and NCT06612268 is recruiting with no approval.

NNC0487-0111 is amycretin, whose INN is zenagamtide (https://chemxplore.com/news/zenagamtide-phase-2-diabetes-results), and both rows run the same AMAZE Phase 3 programme (AMAZE 1 NCT07339423 under the code, AMAZE 13 NCT07668401 under the INN).

Novo GLP-1/GIP/glucagon triple agonist per Synapse (https://synapse.patsnap.com/drug/1aafc4c268bf4462bb9d8e3cafc53fda) in Phase 2 NCT07184632 and NCT07415954, run in parallel with separate UBT251 dose-finding trials (NCT07395687, NCT07668388), which marks it as a different molecule from UBT251.

UBT251 is the GLP-1/GIP/glucagon triple agonist Novo licensed from The United Laboratories in March 2025 (https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/02/24/3243205/0/en/Novo-Nordisk-Triple-agonist-UBT251-delivers-up-to-19-7-mean-weight-loss-after-24-weeks-in-phase-2-trial-in-China.html), in Phase 2 NCT07395687 and NCT07668388 with no approval.

Zenagamtide is the INN for Novo's GLP-1/amylin co-agonist amycretin (https://chemxplore.com/news/zenagamtide-phase-2-diabetes-results), in Phase 3 AMAZE and AMBITION trials (NCT07797335 recruiting) with no approval; the NNC0487-0111 row in this batch points here.

Novo halted HERMES and ATHENA (NCT06200207) on 2026-09-07 after the ZEUS miss, but ARTEMIS (NCT06118281, 10,000 patients after heart attack) continues to an H1 2027 readout (https://finance.yahoo.com/healthcare/articles/novo-scraps-two-more-heart-114434932.html).
177Lu-PSMA-617 is lutetium Lu 177 vipivotide tetraxetan, sold as Pluvicto, which the book carries; NCT04720157 (PSMAddition) is a new-indication study of it.
NCT06894511 on this row is titled Lutetium (177Lu) Vipivotide Tetraxetan (AAA617), the molecule sold as Pluvicto, which the book carries.
ABL001 is the code for asciminib, sold as Scemblix, which the book carries (EMA 2022-08-25 in the dossier); NCT06514534 is a new CML population for it.
NCT07748624 (Phase 2, not yet recruiting) names the drug Arumakimig (MAS825), an IL-1 beta and IL-18 antibody with no approval; clearest name of the two rows for this molecule.
The only trial on this row, NCT05852938, is titled A Study of Zigakibart in Adults With IgA Nephropathy, so BION-1301 duplicates the Zigakibart row in this population.

Novartis said it stopped work on iscalimab (CFZ533) on benefit/risk grounds after its Sjogren's data (https://www.fiercebiotech.com/biotech/novartis-gives-anti-cd40-antibody-treat-sjogrens-due-benefitrisk-profile), and the only trial left, NCT03827798, passed primary completion on 2024-12-04.
The oocysts are the challenge inoculum in NCT07249463, which tests EDI048 in a Cryptosporidium infection model in healthy adults, not a product in development.

CTL019 is tisagenlecleucel, sold as Kymriah, which the book carries; both trials on this row (NCT03876769, NCT04094311) are titled Tisagenlecleucel; approval date: https://www.fda.gov/drugs/resources-information-approved-drugs/fda-approves-tisagenlecleucel-b-cell-all-and-tocilizumab-cytokine-release-syndrome

VAV1 molecular glue degrader MRT-6160 licensed from Monte Rosa, in Phase 2 NCT07801495 (psoriatic arthritis) and NCT07737743 (Sjogren's), both recruiting (https://www.clinicaltrialvanguard.com/news/novartis-pays-50m-milestone-as-mrt-6160-enters-phase-2-for-sjogrens-disease/).

Decitabine appears only as the hypomethylating partner in NCT05201066, a rollover study for patients from prior sabatolimab (MBG453) trials; it is a third-party generic, not a Novartis programme; approval date: https://www.drugs.com/history/dacogen.html
Eltrombopag is sold by Novartis as Promacta, which the book carries, and as Revolade (EMA 2010-03-11 in the dossier); NCT04797000 in lower-risk MDS is a new use of that molecule.
Novartis dengue antiviral in Phase 2 NCT06006559, recruiting, with no approval and no book row.

First compound in the Novartis atopic dermatitis platform NCT06947993 (Phase 2, recruiting), listed as an IL-13 and IL-18 inhibitor with no INN (https://synapse.patsnap.com/drug/cea0a5ec84bd4ed3a54bfc4b9449ad30); no book row matches.

Novartis anti-IL-15 antibody in Phase 2 with NCT07220577 (atopic dermatitis) active not recruiting and NCT07431177 (vitiligo) recruiting; no book row shares the molecule (https://synapse.patsnap.com/drug/c8d1ecce743e4276ab93e08c60cee822).
A strength description of glycopyrronium, sold by Novartis as Seebri Neohaler, which the book carries; NCT05222529 studies it in children with asthma.
Oral muscarinic M4 agonist (EX-A8078) in Phase 2 NCT07467993 for schizophrenia, recruiting, with no approval and no book row (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GXV-813).

Phase 3 NCT05624749 (SIRIUS-SLE 2) is active not recruiting and the drug holds FDA Breakthrough designation (Jan 2026) but no approval (https://www.novartis.com/news/media-releases/novartis-ianalumab-receives-fda-breakthrough-therapy-designation-sjogrens-disease); clearest name of the three ianalumab rows.
A route and schedule description of ianalumab; its trial NCT05126277 (SIRIUS-LN, Phase 3, active not recruiting) belongs with the Ianalumab row.

A misspelling and strength of iptacopan, sold as Fabhalta, which the book carries; NCT05795140 is the aHUS long-term extension titled Iptacopan.

NCT06991556 (Phase 2, active not recruiting) names the drug as JSB462 (luxdegalutamide), an AR degrader with no approval and no other row in the book.

Novartis kinetoplastid proteasome inhibitor in Phase 2 NCT06632600 for chronic Chagas disease, recruiting, with no approval and no book row.

Phase 3 NCT07357727 of pelabresib (DAK539) plus ruxolitinib in myelofibrosis is recruiting and the drug has no FDA or EMA approval.
Oral HDAC6 inhibitor in Phase 2 NCT07217067 for atrial fibrillation, recruiting, with no approval and no book row (https://www.novartis.com/clinicaltrials/study/nct07217067).

Angiotensinogen siRNA licensed from Argo Biopharma as BW-00163, in Phase 2 NCT06857955 (active not recruiting) and NCT07543120 (recruiting) with no book row (https://www.argobiopharma.com/news/111.html).
QMF149 is Atectura Breezhaler, which Novartis already sells in the EU after EC approval in May 2020, and NCT05562466 tests it in children aged 6 to under 12, a new age group.

QVM149 is Enerzair Breezhaler, which Novartis already sells in the EU after EC approval in July 2020 (https://www.novartis.com/news/media-releases/novartis-receives-ec-approval-enerzair-breezhaler-including-first-digital-companion-sensor-and-app-can-be-prescribed-alongside-treatment-uncontrolled-asthma-eu); NCT05776927 seeks a new label for the product.
Novartis CD19 CAR-T (YTB323) with Phase 2 trials such as NCT06581198 in SLE and lupus nephritis active not recruiting; the book matches are other companies' CAR-Ts, not this molecule.
NCT05349214 on this row is titled Ianalumab (VAY736), so VAY736 is the code for the Ianalumab row in this population.
Phase 2 NCT07094516 in early Alzheimer disease is recruiting and NCT06643481 in ALS is active not recruiting; no approval and no book row shares the molecule.
HTT splicing modifier (PTC518) licensed from PTC, in Phase 3 NCT07326709 for Huntington disease, recruiting, with no approval and no book row.

Only NCT07830719 (Phase 2 dose-finding in stable coronary artery disease with elevated hsCRP, not yet recruiting) was found; Amass DrugCore and web search gave no molecule, mechanism or INN for the code.
Anti-APRIL antibody in IgA nephropathy with Phase 3 extension NCT06858319 recruiting and no approval; clearest name of the two rows for this molecule (BION-1301 is the other).
NCT06667453 and NCT07220603 (Phase 2, Recruiting) are PepGen's active DM1 trials of this molecule, which no other row in the book holds.

20vPnC is the book's marketed Prevnar 20 (BLA125731); Phase 3 NCT07754539 only extends it to Chinese infants; approval date: https://www.pfizer.com/news/press-release/press-release-detail/us-fda-approves-prevnar-20tm-pfizers-pneumococcal-20-valent
ATM-AVI is aztreonam-avibactam, approved and sold as Emblaveo, which the book carries under AbbVie (NDA217906); Pfizer holds the EU authorisation, which the book does not model.
Phase 3 NCT05911295 of disitamab vedotin with pembrolizumab in HER2-expressing urothelial cancer is active, not recruiting, and neither the dossier nor the EMA list holds an approval for it.
Encorafenib is the molecule of the book's modelled Braftovi / Mektovi line; EMA lists Braftovi authorised 2018-09-19 for Pierre Fabre; approval date: https://www.drugs.com/history/braftovi.html
Phase 3 NCT06679140 of ibuzatrelvir in non-hospitalised COVID-19 is recruiting; ibuzatrelvir is a separate protease inhibitor from Paxlovid's nirmatrelvir.
Lorlatanib is a misspelling of lorlatinib, marketed in the book as Lorbrena (NDA210868); its only trial NCT05059522 is a continued-access study.

Its only open trial NCT05145127 is the open-label extension of marstacimab, marketed in the book as Hympavzi (BLA761369).

Phase 3 CREST (NCT04165317) met its event-free survival endpoint, and Pfizer withdrew the EU application for Zumrad (sasanlimab) on 2026-02-13 after CHMP concerns (https://www.thepharmaletter.com/biotech-news/pfizer-withdraws-zumrad-ema-filing); no discontinuation is on record, so it is not DEAD.

Pfizer discontinued Beqvez (fidanacogene elaparvovec) in all markets in February 2025 on weak demand (https://www.cgtlive.com/view/pfizer-jettisons-fda-approved-hemophilia-b-gene-therapy-beqvez), and the EMA lists it as withdrawn; FDA approval letter 2024-04-25 (https://www.fda.gov/media/178139/download).

Phase 3 CIFFREO (NCT04281485) missed its primary endpoint in June 2024 and Pfizer discontinued fordadistrogene movaparvovec the following month (https://www.cgtlive.com/view/pfizer-development-dmd-gene-therapy-fordadistrogene-movaparvovec).

column7: Phase 3 NCT06760637 of PF-07220060 with letrozole in HR-positive HER2-negative breast cancer is active, not recruiting, and the book's own trial history titles the molecule Atirmociclib/PF-07220060.
Same code as the PF-07220060 row in this batch; CDK4 inhibitor only restates the mechanism of atirmociclib (NCT06105632, active not recruiting).
Phase 2 BRANCH-HF NCT06991257 in heart failure is recruiting; PF-07328948 is a first-in-class BDK inhibitor (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39560668/).

PF-07868489 is an anti-BMP9 antibody in pulmonary arterial hypertension (https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT06137742); its Phase 2 extension NCT07073820 is active, not recruiting, and the book holds no other row for it.
Phase 2 NCT07216027 of PF-08049820 in eczema is recruiting; Synapse and the trial records describe an oral compound with no INN or mechanism, so identity rests on the code.

PF-08653945 is MET-233i, the monthly amylin analog from Metsera, a different molecule from modelled berobenatide (PF-08653944); Phase 2 NCT07575932 is active, not recruiting (https://pryzm.ozmosi.com/product/34424).
Phase 3 NCT07794748 and NCT07629440 test a new multivalent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine distinct from Prevnar 20, and the book holds no other row for it.
BHV3000 is the code for rimegepant, marketed in the book as Nurtec ODT; Phase 3 NCT04649242 extends it to children and adolescents.
Phase 3 NCT07029711 and NCT07029828 test ritlecitinib, marketed in the book as Litfulo, in children with alopecia areata.
Phase 3 NCT06758401 of sigvotatug vedotin with pembrolizumab in NSCLC is recruiting, and the book holds no other sigvotatug vedotin row.

Phase 3 VERITAC-2 NCT05654623 (ARV-471) reached primary completion on 2025-01-31 and neither the dossier nor the EMA list holds a vepdegestrant approval; a 2026 FDA decision was not verified this session.

NCT06092034 (Phase 2, Recruiting) is still active after FDA lifted the 2025 clinical hold, and Rocket reported safe dosing of three patients under the modified protocol in August 2026 (https://ir.rocketpharma.com/news-releases/news-release-details/rocket-pharmaceuticals-announces-positive-clinical-safety-update).

Rocket stopped investing in RP-L102 in July 2025, withdrew the EU MAA, and withdrew the FDA BLA on 2025-10-03 as part of its pivot to cardiovascular programmes (https://www.pharmaceutical-technology.com/news/rocket-ditches-blood-disorder-gene-therapy-in-ongoing-pipeline-pivot/).
Regeneron's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 lists ALN-ANG3 as an Alnylam-partnered RNAi therapeutic targeting ANGPTL3 in diabetic kidney disease, in Phase 2 NCT07271186 (recruiting).

Regeneron's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 (0000872589-26-000025) reports the first-line metastatic melanoma Phase 3 missed but keeps fianlimab (REGN3767, anti-LAG-3) in adjuvant melanoma (NCT05608291, readout Q4 2026), perioperative melanoma and first-line HNSCC, with no approval.

Regimen of cemiplimab (Libtayo, EMA 2019-06-28, in the book) with fianlimab, an unapproved anti-LAG-3 antibody the book holds as its own Fianlimab row (id 2902); NCT06769698 and NCT06848088 test the pair.
Regeneron's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 lists mibavademab (REGN4461), a leptin receptor agonist antibody, and Phase 3 NCT07220785 in generalized lipodystrophy is recruiting with no approval.

EMA authorised Ordspono (odronextamab) to Regeneron Ireland on 2024-08-22 and Regeneron's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 (0000872589-26-000025) lists it as a marketed product in FL and DLBCL, so these Phase 3 trials (e.g. NCT06091865) seek new lines and a first FDA label.

Regeneron's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 lists olatorepatide (HS-20094), an in-licensed GLP-1/GIP receptor agonist, with Phase 2 NCT07685808 recruiting and a Phase 3 obesity programme set to start in H2 2026.

Pozelimab is already sold as Veopoz but cemdisiran is an unapproved C5 siRNA with no row of its own in the book; NCT05070858 (NIMBLE) tested both, and Regeneron reported FDA and EMA acceptance of cemdisiran filings in gMG (https://investor.regeneron.com/news-releases/news-release-details/cemdisiran-regulatory-submissions-accepted-review-fda-and-ema).

Ravulizumab is Alexion's Ultomiris (EMA 2019-07-02), listed with eculizumab as a comparator or prior-therapy arm in NCT05133531, a trial of Regeneron's pozelimab plus cemdisiran in PNH; approval date: https://www.drugs.com/history/ultomiris.html
NCT07675811 tests Fel d 1 monoclonal antibodies, which Regeneron's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 names freneslerbart-mevonlerbart (REGN1908-1909), a Phase 3 cat allergy therapy with no approval.

Regeneron's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 (0000872589-26-000025) lists REGN13335 as an antagonist antibody to PDGF-B in PAH, in Phase 2 NCT07318597 (recruiting), with no EMA entry and no FDA approval in the local tables.

Regeneron's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 (0000872589-26-000025) states it has discontinued further clinical development of REGN7999, the TMPRSS6 antibody studied in beta-thalassemia iron overload (NCT06421636).

The row is the Part A trevogrumab arm of NCT06299098 (COURAGE, with semaglutide), and Regeneron's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 lists trevogrumab (REGN1033), an unapproved anti-myostatin antibody, in obesity with more Phase 2 data due in H2 2026.
Regeneron's 10-Q filed 2026-07-30 lists ubamatamab (REGN4018), a MUC16xCD3 bispecific, in ovarian cancer and NSCLC, with Phase 2 NCT06787612 and NCT07154290 recruiting and no approval.

FDA issued a CRL for the RGX-121 BLA on 2026-02-07 and REGENXBIO plans to resubmit, so it is unapproved but not abandoned, and NCT07236606 (Phase 3, Active not recruiting) continues (https://www.cgtlive.com/view/fda-slams-regenxbio-mps-ii-gene-therapy-rgx-121-crl).

NCT05693142 (Phase 2/3, Active not recruiting) finished confirmatory dosing, and REGENXBIO plans an accelerated approval BLA in Q3 2026 (https://ir.regenxbio.com/news-releases/news-release-details/regenxbio-completes-dosing-confirmatory-study-rgx-202-marking/).

In NCT06625320, the Phase 3 study of daraxonrasib in previously treated pancreatic cancer, liposomal irinotecan is part of the standard chemotherapy comparator; it is Ipsen's Onivyde (Amass RegulatoryCore, FDA NDA 207793), not a Revolution Medicines product; approval date: https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/drugsatfda_docs/appletter/2015/207793Orig1s000ltr.pdf
Three Revolution Medicines Phase 3 trials are recruiting (NCT07777822, NCT07805954, NCT07621718), and no other row in the book holds zoldonrasib (RMC-9805).
NCT07160634 (IMPACT DUCHENNE, Phase 3, Recruiting) is Solid's registrational trial of this gene therapy, which no other row in the book holds.

SAR442970 is the development code for brivekimig (https://synapse.patsnap.com/drug/16d092b853c24015bae5c9f19ffd5e52), which has its own row in this batch under the clearer name.

SAR443122 is eclitasertib, which Sanofi dropped in ulcerative colitis (NCT05588843), its last indication, at its full-year 2025 results after ending cutaneous lupus in 2023 (https://www.fiercebiotech.com/biotech/sanofi-keeps-mum-future-denali-pact-after-scrapping-final-ripk1-inhibitor).
SAR444336 is a non-beta IL-2 Synthorin with no INN and no row in the book, in Phase 2 NCT07156175 (Recruiting) in microscopic colitis (https://www.sanofi.com/en/clinical-trials/nct07156175).

SAR445399 is an IL-1R3 (IL1RAP) antagonist with no INN and no row in the book (https://synapse.patsnap.com/drug/327ba97f5cb44c96b535ee4ea0c3ec77), in Phase 2 NCT07225569 (Recruiting) in hidradenitis suppurativa.

SAR447537 is efdoralprin alfa (INBRX-101), a recombinant AAT-Fc fusion not in the book that met all primary and key secondary endpoints in the ElevAATe Phase 2 (https://www.sanofi.com/en/media-room/press-releases/2025/2025-10-22-05-00-00-3170787), and extension NCT05897424 is Active not recruiting.

SAR448851 is the oral TREM2 agonist VG-3927 acquired with Vigil Neuroscience, has no INN and no row in the book, and is in Phase 2 TREMHANCE NCT07688213 (Recruiting) (https://www.alzforum.org/therapeutics/sar448851).
The row is an intravenous formulation of sarilumab, marketed subcutaneously as Kevzara in the book (EMA 2017-06-23 per dossier), tested in NCT07704580 in RA and in children with sJIA in NCT02991469.

Tolebrutinib holds an EU authorisation as Cenrifki (2026-06-19, dossier EMA entry) but the book carries neither Cenrifki nor any tolebrutinib row, and the FDA issued a complete response letter in December 2025 (https://www.sanofi.com/en/media-room/press-releases/2025/2025-12-24-06-00-00-3210238).

Venglustat is not in the book, met its primary endpoint in the LEAP2MONO Phase 3 in type 3 Gaucher disease, and was accepted by the FDA for priority review on 2026-05-28 (https://www.sanofi.com/en/media-room/press-releases/2026/2026-05-28-05-00-00-3302498), while the Fabry Phase 3s PERIDOT and CARAT missed.

SRP-9003 has been on FDA clinical hold since July 2025, yet Sarepta kept it as the one LGMD programme it did not pause and still plans a BLA; NCT06246513 (Phase 3) is Active not recruiting, not suspended (https://www.fiercebiotech.com/biotech/sarepta-ldmd-trials-all-hit-fda-hold-amid-newly-surfaced-safety-concerns).
NCT05606614 (REVEAL, Phase 1/2/3, Active not recruiting) is Taysha's pivotal Rett syndrome study, and no other row in the book holds this gene therapy.

Telitacicept holds only China NMPA approvals, held by RemeGen, with no FDA or EMA approval; NCT06456580 and NCT07404865 are Vor's recruiting global Phase 3 trials (https://ir.vorbio.com/news-releases/news-release-details/vor-bio-doses-first-patient-global-phase-3-upstream-sjd).

The row is a registry intervention-type label whose only trial, NCT06832410 (Phase 3, recruiting), tests VX-880 (zimislecel) in type 1 diabetes with a kidney transplant, and VX-880 is modelled in the VRTX book.
ELX/TEZ/IVA is the Trikafta combination, a marketed VRTX row, in long-term safety studies (NCT05331183, NCT06460506), and all three components are approved.

VNZ/TEZ/D-IVA is the Alyftrek triple combination, a marketed VRTX row, here in a long-term safety extension from age 1 (NCT05844449), and every component is approved (EC authorisation 30 June 2025, https://ec.europa.eu/health/documents/community-register/2025/20250630166304/dec_166304_en.pdf).
VX-121 is vanzacaftor, so VX-121/TEZ/D-IVA is the approved Alyftrek combination, a marketed VRTX row, in paediatric and long-term studies (NCT05422222, NCT05444257).
VX-407 is a small molecule for ADPKD with PKD1 variants in an active Phase 2a (NCT07161037), absent from the VRTX book; no INN found.

VX-670 is an Entrada-licensed cyclic-peptide-conjugated oligonucleotide for DM1 with Phase 1/2 GALILEO (NCT06185764) active and an extension (NCT06926621) enrolling, not in the VRTX book (https://www.vrtx.com/our-science/pipeline/myotonic-dystrophy-type-1/).

WVE-N531 is Wave's exon 53 oligonucleotide, a different molecule from Sarepta's Vyondys 53 (golodirsen); Wave intends to file an NDA in 2026, and NCT07209332 is enrolling (https://ir.wavelifesciences.com/news-releases/news-release-details/wave-life-sciences-announces-positive-data-forward-53-clinical).
